notes.title: Camera update and Disc bug fix
notes.notes:
Hello, I have been seeing feedback that the camera is making them feel motion sickness and now there is a new option to disable the player's camera movement. ːsteamthumbsupː

The 2nd thing is the disc bug in the cave level. It is a serious bug but It is fixed now and hopefully for players who experienced that bug, they might able to move on from that level. Really sorry about this.

notes.title: Noosphere in the Steam Autumn Festival
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Noosphere is glad to be a part of Steam Autumn Festival with a free playable demo of the first chapter.

The demo can take around 30-50 minutes to play through. It will show off the story and the gameplay mechanics of the game. Even though it is labelled as a horror game but it is more to the story and puzzle style while the atmosphere can be alittle haunting. 

I will be holding a live streaming of playing the game tomorrow if possible.

notes.title: There Is No Tomorrow' releases on Steam
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33392782/275da6919fb9cf5cdf5184dd92903294d27b068e.jpg[/img]

Get it today while the launch discount lasts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/787120/There_Is_No_Tomorrow

[h1]About[/h1]
'There Is No Tomorrow' is a 3rd person action survival game inspired by The Last of Us & Life is Strange. The story is about Leon who time traveled into the future world that is at the brink of extinction due to a mystery dimensional beings known as 'RA'. 

The game was nominated by Indie Prize Singapore 2017 and showcased by 'Square Enix Collective' in 2018. Recently it was reviewed by IGN SEA.

Features:
⦁        Choose between action or stealth approach
⦁        A story driven adventure game
⦁        Multiple endings based on choices you made
⦁        Challenging Puzzles to solve.
⦁        Hardcore mode (remove listening ability)

notes.title: Noosphere
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35899678/ec8aafe2ce657b02775c70574316e5b6f3895ba6.jpg[/img]

[b]'Noosphere'[/b] is planning to be releasing in 2020. The game is still in the middle of development. 

What does 'Noosphere' means?
[i]"A postulated sphere or stage of evolutionary development dominated by consciousness, the mind, and interpersonal relationships"[/i]

The game got its' inspirations from games & movies such as Outlast and Inception. I am very excited about this game and I hope you will too!
